title: A Survey on Human-AI Collaboration with Large Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Probing LLMs with a 2x2 prompt schema using permutations of complex questions that swap gendered pronouns and occupational roles to quantify stereotypical associations (highlighted via Kotek et al.).
Literature review of existing studies (e.g., Kirk et al.) that document occupational stereotypes and biases in models like GPT-2.
Literature review of existing studies (e.g., Huang et al.) identifying biases related to sensitive societal attributes within AI-generated code.
